text:
Jordan: CI red on main after the serializer change in #1234 — snapshot tests failing for a few prompt/golden tests. Can someone help triage?

CI-bot: CI pipeline failed: https://ci.internal.redwood/runs/98765
- tests/prompt_tests/test_render_snapshots.py::TestPrompts::test_basic_render (diff)
- serialization module mismatch in kv-cache dump

Alex: seen this locally too after pulling main. Diffs look like spacing + escaped tokens in the serialized prompt. Not a huge drift but snapshots assert strict equality.

Priya: quick checks — did we change any default tokenizer/escape behavior in the PR? Or serialization version bump? @Jordan can you paste the failing diff snippet?

Jordan: pasted diff from CI artifacts:
```
- prompt: "Hello, world!"
+ prompt: "Hello, world! "  # non-breaking space
- kv_state: b"\x01\x02..."
+ kv_state: b"\x01\x03..."
```

Ben: That non-breaking space is suspicious — could be normalization change in tokenizer code. Alex — did your PR touch tokenizer or unicode normalization?

Alex: I only touched serializer version header and the TLV layout, not tokenizer. But I did upgrade an npm dep (tokenizer-lib) in the infra bundle that we vendor. Might be related.

Maia: Tagging @oncall since this is a CI blocking failure for main. Do we want to bisect or try a quick rerun with the old serializer flag?

Priya: Repro steps to help whoever bisects:
1) checkout main at failing commit\2) run the single test locally with env to dump serialized artifact:
```bash
export SERIALIZER_DEBUG=1
pytest tests/prompt_tests/test_render_snapshots.py::TestPrompts::test_basic_render -q -k basic_render --maxfail=1 -q
# artifact will be at /tmp/serializer_dump/<testname>/
```
Collect the dump from CI artifacts and local run and do a binary diff.

Ben: I can bisect but need the commit range. Jordan — can you confirm the last green SHA?

Jordan: last green was sha a1b2c3d4 (yesterday morning). Current bad is e5f6g7h8.

Ben: perfect. I'll start a git bisect run and automate the test:
```bash
git bisect start e5f6g7h8 a1b2c3d4
git bisect run ./scripts/ci_bisect_helper.sh tests/prompt_tests/test_render_snapshots.py::TestPrompts::test_basic_render
```
The helper will checkout, build vendor bundle, run the test, and return exit code.

Alex: If it narrows to the vendor tokenizer bump, we should try pinning the vendor artifact or adding a normalization step in serializer. Quick patch could normalize spaces (replace NBSP with space) before writing snapshot, but that's a band-aid.

Priya: Also check for quantization/serialization differences: some KV bytes changed which could indicate a codepath writing a different header byte (version or flag). Check serializer header magic and version field in the dumped artifact.

Maia: If anyone finds the bisect commit, please post the minimal reproduction and I'll open an incident and assign an owner for rollback/hotfix policy.

CI-bot: Rerun request: https://ci.internal.redwood/runs/98765/rerun (triggered by Ben)

Ben: started bisect. If folks want to help speed up, please run the helper locally for commits in the suspected range — it'll save time on our infra quota.

Alex: quick local hack to tolerate NBSP in snapshots while we investigate:
```python
# in snapshot serializer before comparing\text = text.replace('\u00a0', ' ')
# add a TODO to remove after root cause fixed
```
Not ideal but safe for short window. I'll open a tiny PR and mark it as emergency if we need fast green.

Jordan: thanks. Ben — keep us posted on bisect result. Priya — can you collect CI artifacts (both dumps) and drop link here once you have them?

Priya: will do, uploading now to shared artifact store and will paste link.

Maia: assigning to Ben for bisect and Alex for hotfix patch if needed. @Ben @Alex please sync if bisect points to vendor.

Ben: bisect found culprit commit: vendor/tokenizer-lib bump commit 9fa4d2. Repro locally. Opening a revert PR now.

Alex: saw it. Revert PR up: https://git.internal.redwood/pull/1245
I'll also add a normalization test case to prevent future regressions.

Jordan: perfect. Thanks everyone. Leaving this thread open until revert merges and main is green. :thumbsup:
